_README: This file lives in your credit-catalyst project. Update it whenever you add a capability. The pitch deck reads from this file so it always reflects what the system actually does.
_HOW_TO_REGENERATE_DECK: Copy this file next to deck.js, then run: node deck.js

live.name: SEC Filing Monitor
live.description: Scans SEC EDGAR every 1-10 minutes for 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K filings from iTraxx watchlist companies
live.detail: Covers 14 US-listed companies from the 202-name universe. Auto-restarts on reboot.

live.name: AI Filing Analysis
live.description: Claude API summarises each filing and flags credit-relevant language, covenant triggers, and management red flags
live.detail: Basic analysis — scores severity and extracts key phrases

live.name: Telegram Alerts
live.description: Real-time alerts sent to phone when a monitored company files with the SEC
live.detail: Includes filing type, AI summary, and severity flag

live.name: Company Watchlist Database
live.description: 202 companies tracked with ticker, CIK, credit rating, and priority scoring
live.detail: Covers full iTraxx Main and Crossover indices
